The structure of V7Si4 (22 atoms per cell, Z = 4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives Si centers 10 geometric neighbors (2–7 V and Si), while V centers show 13 neighbors (4–9 V and Si), with neighbor distances from roughly 2.15 to 3.28 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 22 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Si 10-vertex polyhedra and between V 13-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Si and V polyhedra.
